prediction_text: The son is at his mother's own house, not with his master. Jupiter, lord of the 5th and significator of the son, is placed in the Ascendant itself, tying the son to the querent's own sphere rather than to the master's house; the Moon in Pisces applying to a sextile of Saturn, lord of the 4th (the mother's dwelling), confirms the son's presence at the dwelling. Timing: the significators of mother and son perfect a trine on 25 July at 2 p.m. — at that point she shall have certain news of him / meet with him (day-scale coordinate: 25 July, 2 p.m.).
basis: 卡面未标注 tradition 字段，按题面体裁自决（Lilly 卜卦占星 horary）。systems_used: horary。已载面：子在师傅处抑或母宅（主问面）、应期面（题面自带三星会合时刻）。断项过闸：子在母宅←五宫主木星入升（指代链：五宫主=子）＋月亮六合四宫主土星（母宅）；应期←题面载母子象征星三合于7月25日14时成相。对象核：承受对象=子，应验对象=子，同一。盘面为原文散述位置、无全图，已据所载位置作断。
